notes: Videos you add now save inside Stowra as real files, so big videos no longer slow the app. Older files move over quietly in the background.
Tap a picture to see it full screen and pinch to zoom. Tap a video to play it right in the app.
New Save to gallery in the Keep menu and in the viewer. Pictures, videos and recordings go to your gallery in a Stowra folder, so other apps can open them.
Pinterest pins now save the real picture in full size, with the title, who pinned it, the board and the link the pin points to.
Backups keep files under 25 MB. Longer videos stay on the phone and the backup says how many were left out.
